text:
Maya: Heads up 10 we need final social assets for the product-launch webinar (next Wed). Request: X & LinkedIn hero, 2 carousel frames, short loop GIF, 3 caption variants, and 2 post-reminders (day-of + 48h replay). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1launch_assets

Leo: I can finish the hero + GIF. ETA EOD tomorrow. Which headline are we using? Current pitch in the brief says 'Reduce inference costs without sacrificing quality.'

Priya: I'd prefer softer language for social. Suggest: 'Predictable, cost-effective LLM inference' or 'Make inference predictable and affordable for your team.'

Jordan: For CTAs: primary = Register, secondary = Read the benchmark. Also note: benchmark page is live: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/inference-economics-2026

Maya: Locking on 'Make inference predictable and affordable' (shorter). Use Register as primary. Priya, can you draft 3 caption options here?

Priya: Caption 1: "Make inference predictable and affordable. Join our webinar to see real-world benchmarks and best practices. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

Priya: Caption 2: "Where latency, cost, and reliability meet. Get the playbook in our webinar. Register now."

Priya: Caption 3: "Curious how teams cut per-token cost without sweating quality? Well walk through benchmarks + tactics. Register."

Leo: Suggest removing 'cut' in caption 3. Maybe 'reduce'.

Priya: Updated caption 3: "Curious how teams reduce per-token cost without sacrificing quality? Well walk through benchmarks + tactics. Register."

OpsBot: Posting windows reminder: X (Tue 10:30 PT), LinkedIn (Tue 11:00 PT). Use campaign tag webinar_may_2026.

Maya: Need two follow-ups: Day-of reminder short copy and 48h replay. Priya, can you add those lines?

Priya: Day-of: "Starts today at 10am PT 10 last seats!" Replay: "Missed it? Watch the replay: https://redwood.ai/replay/webinar-may-2026"

Jordan: Routing: add hidden field lead_source=social_webinar and tag 'webinar_may_2026'. SDR_Router will pick up. @SDR_Router please confirm mapping to HubSpot lists.

SDR_Router: Confirmed. Hidden field added -> inbound mapping: webinar_may_2026 -> list Webinar_May_2026 -> owner rotation. Include fields: email, company_name, company_size, region.

Leo: Uploaded proof images: hero_v2.png, carousel_a.png, carousel_b.png, loop_tease.gif (3.2MB). Put notes in drive.

Maya: Thanks. Quick QA: make sure gif under 5MB for X. Good. Priya  can you post final caption choice? Team vote here.

Priya: I vote caption 1 (straightforward).

Jordan: Caption 1 is fine. I like the benchmark CTA in the secondary link.

Maya: Okay caption 1 locked. Leo, replace headline on hero to match locked phrase and re-upload by EOD.

Leo: Will do. Re-uploading now as hero_final_may.png.

OpsBot: Buffer command for scheduler (example):
```
buffer schedule --profile redwood-x --file hero_final_may.png --caption "Make inference predictable and affordable. Join our webinar to see real-world benchmarks and best practices. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar" --time "2026-05-12T10:30:00-07:00"
```

Maya: Jordan  could you add UTM params for social campaign? utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=webinar_may_2026

Jordan: Done. Also enabling comment monitoring on X thread and a daily digest to #sales for leads with >50 employees.

SDR_Router: Note: please include a hidden field 'company_size_bucket' if possible to speed up triage.

Maya: Great. Timeline recap: assets by EOD tomorrow (Leo), captions locked now (Priya), form hidden fields live (Jordan) by EOD today, scheduler run on Mon at noon PT. Anything else?

Leo: Gif optimized, images exported as PNG-24, carousels sized for LinkedIn 1080x1080.

Priya: I'll prepare 2 alt captions for paid boost if needed.

Maya: Thanks all :rocket:
